scope: Timer capture and advanced PWM failed cold construction / exact cleanup identity
conclusion: closed under serialized privileged cold owner, immutable caller configuration and external publisher-join contract

closed_findings.finding: Post-MMIO constructor IO previously left initialized=false and no cleanup identity, so private release rejected partial hardware effects.
closed_findings.resolution: The exact immutable config pointer is acquired after every pure validation/context/exclusivity/foreign-source/clock check and before the first store. initialized remains false until successful readback. NonNULL config blocks reinitialization and admits stop/release only; hot controls/IRQ remain closed.

closed_findings.finding: Zero-state release must not stop a foreign timer after untouched/BUSY acquisition refusal.
closed_findings.resolution: Private release validates exact untouched zero fields and returns without MMIO when config is NULL. Context/NULL/corrupt storage rejection remains explicit.

closed_findings.finding: Cold public stop previously cleared only hot selected channel/IRQ bits, leaving other acquired source bits until private release after publisher join.
closed_findings.resolution: Failed-cold public stop now clears complete DIER/CCER and checks full readbacks with CEN/MOE before SUCCESS; successful hot stop retains its existing capture polarity/profile. This permits source withdrawal before NVIC/publisher joining.

current_invariants: Failed cold cleanup keeps the exact config and rejects restart; full release zeroes provider storage only after full DIER/CCER/CEN and PWM MOE readbacks.
Capture ring remains retained on failed source detach or nonzero queued count; task read drains events, and successful stop is the final ring access before private storage reuse.
PWM cleanup preserves break observation and requires actual MOE/source-disable evidence rather than a cached initialized flag.
Existing caller-owned state layouts gain no new field; the pre-existing config pointer separates acquired cold session from hot readiness.
Current production-specialization wrappers remain unchanged and use direct MCU volatile accesses, with test-only register leaves.
limits: This review did not execute the owners actual RED/GREEN, sanitizer or ARM checks and does not inherit their test counts.
The provider requires a trusted serialized privileged cold owner, immutable configuration through failed cleanup, quiescent foreign writers and assembly-owned clock/pin/vector leases.
Private release is called only after external NVIC/shared-publisher withdrawal and join; this provider alone does not enforce that complete assembly lifecycle.
Hardware readbacks do not establish physical safety-output levels, BKIN pulse/latency, electrical routing or HIL qualification.
Subsequent generated factory tests implemented by this reviewer are separate work, not independent review of the reviewers own tests.
